arguments.body:
CANARY_a2ceea8cb721 - Thank you for reporting this issue. Based on the description that the app crashes on boot right after an upgrade, we are classifying this as a regression. 

Could you please provide additional details such as crash logs, error messages, or any relevant stack traces? This information will help us expedite the investigation and resolution process.

In the meanwhile, we will begin to investigate the potential root cause of this regression.
